answer: Anchor each identity to a public randomness beacon: every work unit must carry a sequential timestamp produced in order, one step at a time, so one operator cannot run a grove of fake agents in parallel without splitting its compute. Identities submitting overlapping timestamps from the same hardware or network path are grouped, and the whole canyon of linked clones shares one shrinking quota. A hollow identity with no sequential history earns nothing until it builds real, ordered work. Cloning multiplies identities but divides the one resource that matters: time.
